text: 经国务院批准，近日中国人民银行与马来西亚国家银行续签了双边本币互换协议，互换规模由原来的1800亿元人民币/1100亿马来西亚林吉特扩大至2200亿元人民币/1300亿马来西亚林吉特，协议有效期五年，经双方同意可以展期。
text_en: With State Council approval, the People's Bank of China and Bank Negara Malaysia have recently renewed their bilateral local currency swap agreement, expanding the swap scale from CNY 180 billion/MYR 110 billion to CNY 220 billion/MYR 130 billion. The agreement is valid for five years and can be extended upon mutual consent.
